levels.title: Egg Hunt
levels.intro: Welcome to Dino Valley, Explorer! The dinosaurs left eggs everywhere! Tap each one and count with me.

rounds.success: Two dino eggs! Wobble, wobble!

rounds.prompt: More eggs! Tap and count them all!
rounds.success: Three eggs! The mamas will be so happy!

rounds.prompt: Footprints! Tap each one and count!
rounds.success: Four big stomps! A dinosaur walked here!

levels.title: Who's That Dino?
levels.intro: Dinosaurs are hiding in the valley! When I call one, tap it as fast as you can!

rounds.question: Tap the T. rex!
rounds.spoken: Can you find the T. rex?
rounds.success: Roar! You found the T. rex!
rounds.hint: The T. rex stands up tall with big teeth!

rounds.question: Tap the long neck dinosaur!
rounds.spoken: Now find the dinosaur with the long, long neck!
rounds.success: Yes! Its neck is long like a slide!
rounds.hint: Look for the neck that reaches way up high!

rounds.question: Tap the dinosaur egg!
rounds.spoken: Where is the dinosaur egg hiding?
rounds.success: That's the egg! Shhh, a baby dino is sleeping inside!
rounds.hint: The egg is smooth and white, not bumpy like a rock!

rounds.question: Tap the dinosaur bone!
rounds.spoken: Dino diggers look for bones! Can you find one?
rounds.success: A dino bone! You're a real fossil finder!
rounds.hint: A bone is white with two bumpy ends!

rounds.question: Tap the volcano!
rounds.spoken: Last one! Find the rumbly volcano!
rounds.success: The volcano! Rumble, rumble, boom!
rounds.hint: The volcano is the mountain with hot orange lava on top!

levels.title: Dino Dinner
levels.intro: The dinosaurs are hungry! Drag each snack to the friend who loves it most.

matchPairs.prompt: Drag each snack to the right friend!

pairs.success: Munch! The long neck loves leaves!
The little lizard catches the bug!
Snap! The crocodile catches a fish!
The egg is safe and cozy in the nest!
The butterfly sips the sweet flower!

levels.title: Nest Numbers
levels.intro: The mama dinos are sorting their nests! Count what's in each group, then drag it to the right nest.

sortBins.prompt: Count each group, then drag it to its nest!
sortBins.spoken: Count carefully, then find the nest with that number!

levels.title: Growing Up Dino
levels.intro: Every big dinosaur starts as a tiny egg! Tap the pictures in order to watch a dino grow up.

rounds.prompt: Tap them in order! The egg comes first!
rounds.spoken: How does a dino grow? The egg comes first!
rounds.success: Egg, hatchling, big dino! It grew up!

rounds.prompt: A T. rex is growing! Start with the egg!
rounds.spoken: Now watch a T. rex grow! Start with the egg!
rounds.success: From tiny egg to mighty T. rex! Roar!

levels.title: Footprint Trail
levels.intro: A dinosaur stomped through the valley! Follow the trail and count everything it left behind. Big numbers ahead!

rounds.prompt: Tap each footprint and count to five!
rounds.success: Five stomps! Stomp, stomp, stomp!

rounds.prompt: Bones on the trail! Count them all!
rounds.success: Six dino bones! What a find!

rounds.prompt: Seven eggs! Can you count that high?
rounds.success: Seven eggs! That's a whole dino family!

levels.title: Nest Watch
levels.intro: Some nests are full and some are almost empty! Look at both sides and tell me which has more, and which has fewer.

rounds.question: Which nest has MORE eggs?
rounds.spoken: Look at both nests! Which has more eggs?
rounds.success: Yes! Five eggs is more than two!
rounds.hint: Count each side! More means a bigger number!

rounds.question: Which side has MORE footprints?
rounds.success: Four is more than one! Stomp, stomp!

rounds.question: Which side has FEWER bones?
rounds.spoken: Tricky one! Which side has fewer bones?
rounds.success: Three is fewer than six! Fewer means less!

rounds.question: Which side has MORE leaves?
rounds.spoken: The long necks are hungry! Which side has more leaves?
rounds.success: Five leaves! The long necks will feast!

rounds.question: Which side has FEWER eggs?
rounds.spoken: Last one! Which side has fewer eggs?
rounds.success: Two is fewer than four! You've got it!

levels.title: Volcano Countdown
levels.intro: The volcano is getting rumbly! Tap the numbers from biggest to smallest and count down to the big boom!

rounds.spoken: Count down for the volcano! Three comes first!
rounds.success: Three, two, one... BOOM! Rumble rumble!

rounds.prompt: A bigger rumble! Count down from five!
rounds.success: Five, four, three, two, one... BOOM! The dinos all cheered!

levels.title: Zibb's Dino Quiz
levels.intro: It's the great dino quiz! Show me everything you've learned, Explorer. The dinosaurs are all watching!

rounds.question: Tap the T. rex!
rounds.spoken: First one! Find the T. rex!
rounds.success: Roar! That's the T. rex!
rounds.hint: The T. rex stands tall with big teeth!

rounds.question: What does the long neck eat? Tap it!
rounds.spoken: What does the long neck dinosaur love to eat?
rounds.success: Leaves! Munch, munch, munch!
rounds.hint: The long neck reaches up high for green food!

rounds.question: Tap the group with EIGHT eggs!
rounds.spoken: Count carefully! Which group has eight eggs?
rounds.success: Eight eggs! What a big nest!
rounds.hint: Eight is a lot! Count each egg!

rounds.question: Tap the group with MORE bones!
rounds.success: Nine is more than six! Amazing counting!

rounds.question: Tap the group with TEN footprints!
rounds.spoken: The biggest count of all! Find ten footprints!
rounds.success: TEN stomps! You did it, Explorer! All the dinosaurs are roaring for you!
rounds.hint: Ten is the biggest! Count every footprint!
